set.body:
Problem: this surface is central enough that implementation should not self-certify. The final state needs an explicit API and boundary audit after the child design slices land.

Work: review modules/dataset, direct consumers in model/fit/mvpa-dataset/group, README/module-relations/build.sbt consistency, and JVM/JS tests. Confirm the public API is Oderskyan Scala 3: typed ADTs and opaque ids where they buy safety, no accidental BIDS or fit-kernel leakage, and explicit compatibility wrappers for legacy throwing methods.

Acceptance: audit findings are either fixed or filed as follow-up motes; dataset README and docs/module-relations.md match the code; datasetJVM/test and datasetJS/test pass; any broader compile/testAll limitations are documented with exact blockers.
set.title: Dataset: final API audit and module-map release gate
